widget.description: Complete metric widget definition for create or full replacement. Omitted fields are dropped on replacement. source may reference the metric; parameters.metricOption carries the SDM identifiers. Upsert defines the widget only; it neither places it nor changes existing placements.

id.description: Existing widget ID. Required when fully replacing a persisted widget; omit when creating a widget. Never invent this value. An unsaved draft widget has no ID and may be replaced by matching widget.name.

name.description: Stable widget key, e.g. "metric_1". On persisted replacement, it must match the widget identified by id.

actions.description: Optional click/select interactions. Full per-type shape: _shared-widget-fields.json.

dynamicTokens.description: Optional dynamic value bindings keyed by token name (e.g. referenced from metricOption.layout). Full shape: _shared-widget-fields.json.

showForecast.description: Whether to show a forecast on the metric card.

layout.description: Metric layout settings keyed by setting name. No fixed schema — pass through settings as given rather than inventing keys.

receiveFilterSource.description: Which published filters this widget listens to. Full shape: _shared-widget-fields.json#/receiveSources/receiveFilterSource.
